info.description:
Expense Management Portal API. **The OpenAPI document is the contract.**

* Money is a string with 2 decimals (`"1250.00"`); never send floats.
* Timestamps are ISO 8601 in UTC with offset; dates are `YYYY-MM-DD`.
* Lists accept `page`, `page_size`, `sort`, `order`; the total is in `X-Total-Count`.
* Errors are `{detail, code, errors[]}`; codes are listed at `GET /api/meta/enums`.
* UIs render buttons from `GET /api/expenses/{id}/allowed-actions` and
  permissions from `GET /api/auth/me` - never from hardcoded role checks.
info.title: Expense Management Portal

Returns a short-lived access token and a rotating refresh token. LOGIN_MAX_FAILED_ATTEMPTS wrong passwords in a row lock the account for LOGIN_LOCKOUT_MINUTES. Rate-limited per IP. An unknown user, a wrong password and a locked account with a wrong password all get the same 401 INVALID_CREDENTIALS (no username enumeration); only with the right password does the answer say the account is locked (423, errors[0].locked_until) or switched off (403 ACCOUNT_INACTIVE).
